examples.title: Calculating Landing Spot
examples.problem: A grasshopper takes jumps of 7 steps. Where will it be after 6 jumps?
examples.explanation: Each jump adds 7 to the total distance.

examples.title: Meeting on the Number Line
examples.problem: Frog (2-step jumps) and Rabbit (5-step jumps) start at 0. At what point will they first meet?
examples.solution: Multiples of 2: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10... Multiples of 5: 5, 10... First common is 10.
examples.explanation: We find the L.C.M of the jump sizes.

examples.title: Number of Jumps
examples.problem: A deer reaches 45 by jumping 9 steps at a time. How many jumps did it take?
examples.explanation: Divide the final position by the jump size to find the count of jumps.
